column1: # issue 1317 part 5 -- the ONE shared parity table for the recordings-retention decision.
# Read by BOTH tests/recordings_retention.rs (against the canonical pure Rust plan()) and
# decision in scripts/strih-recordings-retention.sh, run over a real fixture dir). Both assert
# the SAME expected keep/delete sets below, so the Linux executor is pinned to the Rust authority
# on identical inputs. Edit a case here and BOTH sides must still agree.
#   file <age_seconds> <size_bytes> <name>     (mtime = now - age; a negative age = future mtime)
#   delete <name>                              (in plan order: newest first, name asc on a tie)
# Integer ages only (the Linux executor reads whole-second mtimes).
